title: 第7章 瞎编吐纳术第8章 萧火火自我脑补这才是高人风范
slug: 说好武侠世界你怎么教人修仙
lines: 茅屋之中。
簫火火紧张的，左右看了一眼。
这间屋舍，除了一张老旧木床，一张桌子，几本书，一副碗筷之外，就再无他物。
简陋，单调，处处透著一种超脱俗世的孤寂之感。
话本之中，高人的居住之所，便是这种地方。
“簫火火！”
楚风话音落下，便是惊得呆愣的少年连忙跪下，惊颤著声道：
“弟子在！”
楚风坐在床榻，看向簫火火十分满意，他幽幽的道：
“很好，那为师现在就传你链气之法。”
“我说，你做。”
“万不可有一步差池。”
“起身。”
伏跪在地上的少年一声站了起来。
楚风继续道：
“依照著为师的模样，盘腿坐下。”
簫火火坐在地上，眼睛一边盯在楚风身上，一边调整自己的坐姿。
还未坐好，便是听到了楚风的声音：
“感受天地间的灵气。”
“感受灵气，就是链气的第一步。”
“只有感受到了天地灵气的存在，才能算有链气天赋。”
话罢，簫火火紧张的盘腿而坐，稳住心跳，深呼吸令自己强行冷静下来。
楚风所说的话，令他压力倍增。
感受到天地灵气，才算有链气的天赋。
万一，他感受不到呢？
那此前的一切，都会化作泡影？
此般思绪上头，令得他心神大乱，心中生起一丝烦躁。
簫火火猛然摇头，內心不断的对著自己道：
“没事的簫火火，要相信自己。”
“我虽然没有武修的天赋，但万一有链气的天赋呢？”
“更何况，有这样一个神仙师尊在，我就算没有这方面的天赋，师尊也不会对我置之不理的。”
“他也一定会帮我想办法！”
这般想著，萧火火的心便是彻底静了下来。
而耳边，楚风的引导还在悠悠响起：
content_en:
Among the huts.
Xiao Huohuo looked around nervously.
There is nothing else in this house except an old wooden bed, a table, a few books, and a pair of dishes and chopsticks.
Simple and monotonous, there is a sense of loneliness that transcends the world.
In the storybook, the place where an expert lives is this kind of place.
"Xiao Huohuo!"
After Chu Feng finished speaking, the stunned young man quickly knelt down and said with a trembling voice:
"The disciple is here!"
Chu Feng sat on the bed and looked at Xiao Huohuo with great satisfaction. He said quietly:
"Very good, my master will now teach you the method of chaining qi."
"I said, you do it."
"There must be no mistake."
"Get up."
The boy who was kneeling on the ground stood up with a cry.
Chu Feng continued:
"Sit cross-legged as you would a teacher."
Xiao Huohuo sat on the ground, staring at Chu Feng while adjusting his sitting posture.
Before I could sit down, I heard Chu Feng’s voice:
"Feel the aura between heaven and earth."
"Feeling spiritual energy is the first step to chain energy."
"Only when you feel the existence of the spiritual energy of heaven and earth can you be considered to have the talent of chain energy."
After saying this, Xiao Huohuo sat cross-legged nervously, steadying his heartbeat, and took a deep breath to calm himself down.
What Chu Feng said doubled his pressure.
Only when you feel the aura of heaven and earth can you have the talent of chaining aura.
What if he can't feel it?
Then everything before that will be in vain?
Such thoughts made him confused and a little irritated in his heart.
Xiao Huohuo shook his head suddenly and kept saying to himself in his heart:
"It's okay Xiao Huohuo, you have to believe in yourself."
"Although I don't have the talent for martial arts, what if I have the talent for linking energy?"
"What's more, with such a divine master here, even if I don't have the talent in this area, the master will not ignore me."
"He will definitely help me find a way!"
Thinking like this, Xiao Huohuo's heart completely calmed down.
In my ears, Chu Feng’s guidance was still ringing:
title_en: Chapter 7: Making up the art of vomiting Chapter 8: Xiao Huohuo makes up his own mind, this is the style of a master
